findings.summary: A stale reasoning completion reopens an already-finalized output index after the newer item completes.
findings.failure_scenario: Reasoning item 2 starts and is finalized when item 7 is selected; item 7 then completes and resets ActiveThinkingItemKey. A delayed response.output_item.done for item 2 arrives afterward. codexThinkingItemIsActive treats the empty active key as accepting any item, so the stale event emits a second signature-only thinking start/signature/stop lifecycle at output_index 2.
findings.required_change: Retain completed reasoning-item identity or per-item lifecycle state so completion events for already-finalized items remain no-ops even when no newer item is active, and add a regression where the stale older done arrives after the newer reasoning item has fully completed.

review_summary: Independent reconstruction confirmed the exact scope, hashes, forward/reverse trees, and supplied test suites, but r03 still violates reasoning-item identity: a delayed stale done arriving after the newer item completes duplicates the old output_index lifecycle. Reject and mint a corrected immutable revision.
